note: One entry per guide id (see guides.json). 'status' is 'supplied' when a real Cloudinary asset is configured and 'placeholder' when none has been provided yet: placeholders never show a made-up picture, only a labelled neutral tile. Images with a 'license' were taken from Wikimedia Commons (public domain, CC0 or CC BY-SA) and uploaded to the Cloudinary folder sms/pooja; the credit line is shown under the picture. To add or replace an image, upload it to your Cloudinary Media Library, then set publicId (and resourceType) here. resourceType is 'image' for a photo/artwork or 'video' to use the first frame of a video you already uploaded. Never put API keys or secrets in this file.
